propositions: The live-DC readiness gate polls only serverInfo 200 and does not verify that required custom fields (Epic Link, Epic Name) are registered, allowing the harness to declare an instance ready before the plugin's fields are available

A gap exists between the probe workflow (which waits for field inventory after fix 1387) and the harness workflow (which still waits only on serverInfo), creating drift in their readiness definitions and making the harness vulnerable to the same timing flake the probe was fixed for

Tests confirm that serverInfo returning 200 with only system fields (27 total, zero customfield_*) occurs in the real live-DC image, proving the readiness gate is too weak and the harness margin is incidental rather than safe

The shared readiness definition must verify field presence under a bounded budget and distinguish 'fields not yet registered' from 'image does not offer this plugin' to avoid misattributing timing flakes to image degradation
Both the harness and probe workflows must use a single shared readiness predicate so their implementations cannot diverge, with tests pinning that a system-only field inventory reads as NOT ready
